TOK PISIN

By Talissa Siganto

Topic:Courts

Thu 18 Jun 2026 at 10:34am

Thu 18 Jun 2026 at 1:24pm

Maree Mavis Crabtree has been cleared of all murder charges. (AAP: Jason O'Brien)

A Gold Coast woman accused of killing two of her adult children five years apart has been cleared of all murder charges.

In 2018, Maree Mavis Crabtree was arrested over the deaths of Jonathan Crabtree in 2017 and Erin Crabtree in 2012.

It was alleged by police at the time she drugged her children, aged 18 and 26, with prescription pain medication, then staged their overdoses.

Last month, Ms Crabtree faced a trial in the Supreme Court in Brisbane, in relation to the death of Mr Crabtree.

She pleaded not guilty to his murder, an earlier attempted murder and fraud, and ultimately a jury acquitted her of all three charges.

Jonathan Crabtree died in 2017. (Twitter: Maree Crabtree)

On Thursday, several other charges, including the murder of Erin Crabtree, were discontinued by the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

During a review, in which Ms Crabtree was not present, the court heard two indictments, including a charge that would be discharged.

In a statement, a spokesperson for the ODPP said the outcome of the most recent trial triggered a reassessment of the outstanding charges.

"A review was undertaken of admissible evidence remaining against her in the subsequent proceedings, and a determination made that there were no longer reasonable prospects of conviction in the matters," the statement said.

At the murder trial, the prosecution's case relied heavily on allegations made by Ms Crabtree's other daughter.

Tara Crabtree told the jury she watched her mother mix and serve her brother a blended fruit smoothie laced with a lethal dose of liquid Oxycodone.

Tara Crabree's evidence was repeatedly criticised by her mother's defence lawyer.  (ABC News)

However, her credibility as a witness was questioned and her evidence was criticised repeatedly by Ms Crabtree's defence lawyer, and jurors were told her version of events was made up.

Ms Crabtree was still awaiting trial for her daughter's alleged murder, but at an earlier committal hearing in 2021, the court heard it was alleged she was killed shortly before the rest of her family went on a cruise.

The ABC has contacted Ms Crabtree for comment.
